purpose: Transformer les enseignements UI/UX de MadaNotes en composants, thèmes, presets, templates et runtime génériques sans logique métier.
principles_added: UI action icons use monochrome SVG currentColor
Hero width is content-aligned and context-aware
Foldable state is a component property, not DOM inference
Light and full sites share the same framework and differ through presets
Business data never enters generic framework components
next_steps: Implement navigation/header renderer from project configuration
Implement full eight-direction contextual-help panel runtime
Add automated smoke tests for the generic demo
Add additional templates: documentation-index, calculator, upload, help-center
